vision.name: Blue Blurred Blast
vision.text:
(Heroes only. If this card is discarded from your hand by a Mastery effect, you may banish it to search your discard pile for an Ally and play it.)
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
Attach to your MP. While attached, you may banish this card as an action to make your attacks considered Styled this combat. Banish this card when your opponent advances a level.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
(Created by Andrew Bjornstad, OP4 Supreme Kai Champion)
